notes: the saying («قال كنا نصومه ثم ترك») is spoken by Abdullah inside the scene where al-Ash'ath enters on him; a Companion speaking in a narrated encounter is the rule 11 case, so the chain is read to قيس بن سكن and Abdullah is not added; the two branches are the two taḥwīl routes; «- واللفظ له -» is a gloss
